# Gumroad API

Gumroad Discover search, products, reviews and creator profiles as JSON, with no access token.

The API.SH Gumroad API turns public Gumroad pages into structured JSON. Search Discover by words, category, tags, file types, price range and minimum rating with every sort the site offers, and list the full category tree. Read a product's price and USD price, pay-what-you-want and rental prices, membership tiers, options with stock, rating with star breakdown, sales count when shown, refund policy and bundle contents. Page through a product's reviews with seller replies, and read a creator's profile with bio, rating, social links and products. It covers any seller's public listings, which a seller's own API token does not give you.

- **5** endpoints
- from **$1** / 1,000 calls
- **1,000** free credits / month
- failed calls **free**

*Gumroad search*

```
GET https://api.api.sh/gumroad/v1/search
```

## What you can build with the Gumroad API

### Niche and market research for creators

Search a category or tag sorted by most reviewed or hot and new to see which ebooks, templates or courses sell, at what prices and with which file types.

### Competitor pricing

Track competitors' prices, tiers, options and sales counts where shown, and catch price changes or new bundles.

### Review mining

Read a product's reviews with ratings, text, dates and seller replies to learn what buyers value before you build your own.

### Creator outreach and partnerships

Find creators in a niche through search, then read their profiles for bio, X and YouTube links, rating and product count.

### Curated catalogs and directories

Build a directory of digital products by category with names, prices, ratings, thumbnails and seller details.

## Gumroad API endpoints and prices

Every Gumroad endpoint costs 1 credit per call: credits are $1 per 1,000 on a monthly plan, $2 pay-as-you-go. [Pricing](https://api.sh/pricing)

## Call the Gumroad API

Gumroad search: GET https://api.api.sh/gumroad/v1/search

```
curl "https://api.api.sh/gumroad/v1/search?q=notion&sort=highest_rated&page=1" \
  -H "x-api-key: $APISH_KEY"
```

1. **Create a free account**Confirm your email and get 1,000 free credits every month. No card needed.
2. **Create an API key**One key works for all 917 platforms.
3. **Send the request**JSON back in one call. Add `output=csv` or `output=ndjson` for files.

## Why API.SH for Gumroad data

- Public data only: no Gumroad login, cookies or account needed
- One key and one response shape for Gumroad and 916 other platforms
- Built and maintained by API.SH, not third-party publishers
- Pay per call; errors on our side cost nothing
- No rate limits: run as many calls in parallel as you need
- Live [status](https://status.api.sh) for every endpoint

## API.SH vs the official Gumroad API

Gumroad has an official API: a seller creates an application and an access token to manage their own products, sales and subscribers and to verify license keys. It works on your own account only. API.SH needs no token or app and returns public Discover listings, products, reviews and creator profiles from any seller.

Instead of an Apify Gumroad actor, a no-code tool such as Axiom or your own scraper, use one API.SH key with the same JSON shape as every other platform and a fixed price per call.

## Gumroad API questions

What Gumroad data can I get?+

Discover search with filters and sorts (/gumroad/v1/search), the category tree (/gumroad/v1/categories), one product with prices, tiers, options and rating breakdown (/gumroad/v1/product), product reviews (/gumroad/v1/reviews) and creator profiles (/gumroad/v1/creator).

How much does the Gumroad API cost?+

Every Gumroad endpoint costs 1 credit per call. On a monthly plan 1,000 credits cost $1 (Starter is $50/month for 50,000 credits). Pay-as-you-go is $2 per 1,000 credits, with top-ups from $15 that never expire.

Is there a free trial?+

Yes. Every account gets 1,000 free credits every month. That is 1,000 calls to /gumroad/v1/categories at 1 credit each.

Is there an official Gumroad API?+

Yes, for sellers. Gumroad's API uses an access token from an application you create in your Gumroad settings, and it manages your own products, sales and license keys. It does not search Discover or read other sellers' products, which API.SH does.

Do I need a Gumroad account or API key?+

No. You need only an API.SH key. API.SH reads public Gumroad pages and never signs in or makes purchases.

Can I see how many sales a Gumroad product has?+

When the product page shows a sales count, /gumroad/v1/product returns it, along with the rating, star breakdown and stock left.

Can I use the Gumroad API from Python?+

Yes. Use the API.SH Python SDK or any HTTP client with your key in the x-api-key header, for example /gumroad/v1/search?q=notion+template, and read the JSON.

How do I get started?+

1. Sign up at api.sh. 2. Copy your API key. 3. Call /gumroad/v1/search with q, or /gumroad/v1/product with the url of a Gumroad product. Every parameter is in the docs at https://api.sh/docs. You can also use the JS or Python SDK, Google Sheets, Zapier, Make, n8n or the MCP server at https://api.sh/mcp.

Does the Gumroad API have a rate limit?+

No. API.SH puts no rate limit on your key: send as many Gumroad calls in parallel as you need and pay only for the calls that run. If Gumroad itself slows down, the call returns 503 with a retry-after header and is not charged.
